bio: PROFILE OF PROFESSOR (MRS) CHINWENDU ALICE UZUKE Prof Chinwendu Alice Uzuke was born on the 27th December 1969. She hails from Anambra State, Nigeria. She earned her B.Sc in Statistics and Demography from Nnamdi Azikiwe University Awka, Msc in Applied Statistics (Biostatistics) from Nnamdi Azikiwe University, Awka and PhD in Statistics (Regression Analysis) from Nnamdi Azikiwe University, Awka, Nigeria. Presently, she is Professor in the Department of Statistics, Nnamdi Azikiwe University, Awka, Nigeria. She has attended many workshops and conferences where she presented her work. She has published widely in both local and international journals. She is a member of relevant professional and Academic bodies like Nigeria Statistical Association, Organization for women in Sciences for the Developing World (OWSDW), International Statistics Institute and International Association of Statistics Education. She is in-charge of Evaluation and Monitoring in South East Zone of LISA 2020 Global Network She is a member of African Women in Leadership Organization (AWLO) and Soroptimist International (SI). Her research interest is in Biostatistics, Regression Analysis Geospatial Statistical Modelling and Non-Parametrics.

bio: Dr Chibuzor Nnanatu is a talented Lecturer with the Department of Statistics, Nnamdi Azikiwe University Awka. My areas of expertise span over Bayesian statistics, Computational statistics, and Spatial & Spatio-temporal statistical modelling with focus on tackling topical environmental and public health issues including environmental pollution,  and promotion of child and maternal health. I have a BSc (Unizik), MSc (Unizik) and PhD (Lancaster) all in statistics with teaching and research experience spanning over 12 years. My current research activities evolve around the development of novel Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) algorithms and integrated nested Laplace approximation (INLA) techniques for the analysis of complex household surveys data such as the Demographic and Health Survey (DHS) and Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey (MICS), and data emanating from partially observed complicated endemic diseases including Covid-19.
specialization: Bayesian Statistics, Biostatistics, Child And Maternal Health, Computational Statistics, Environmental Statistics, Epidemic Modelling, Machine Learning And Artificial Intelligence (AI), Medical Statistics, Modelling Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) Indicators Including Gender-based Violence And Good Health For All, Population Modelling And Estimation, Power Analysis, Spatial And Spatio-temporal Modelling, Statistical Software Package Development

bio: Dr. Samuel Ugochukwu Enogwe is a distinguished academic and researcher with extensive expertise in Statistics, Operations Research, and Economics. He began his academic journey at the Federal Polytechnic Nekede, Owerri, Nigeria, earning a Higher National Diploma (HND) in Statistics with Distinction in November 2011. He proceeded to Michael Okpara University of Agriculture, Umudike, where he obtained a B.Sc. in Statistics with First Class Honours in November 2015, followed by an M.Sc. in Operations Research in August 2018, graduating as the Overall Best M.Sc. student with a perfect C.G.P.A. of 5.00/5.00. He subsequently earned a Ph.D. in Statistics (Operations Research) from Nnamdi Azikiwe University, Awka, in January 2023, receiving recognition as the Best Graduating Ph.D. student of the Department of Statistics for the 2022/2023 session. Complementing his postgraduate studies, he obtained a Postgraduate Diploma (PGD) in Economics with Distinction from Michael Okpara University of Agriculture, Umudike, in January 2026 and is currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Development Economics at the same institution. Dr. Enogwe’s research interests span Statistics, Operations Research, and Economics. His work focuses on developing Batch Arrival Non-Markovian queueing models, designing new statistical distributions for real-world applications, and exploring econometric modeling in development economics. He is highly proficient in statistical and computational tools, including R, Python, and other software packages essential for data-driven research. He has deployed innovative teaching and learning methods to make Statistics accessible and engaging for students and has served as an internal examiner for both Masters’ degree and Ph.D. students. He began his lecturing career at the Department of Mathematics/Statistics, Federal Polytechnic Nekede, Owerri, where he contributed significantly to teaching, research, and community development. He joined Michael Okpara University of Agriculture, Umudike, in 2019 and has been instrumental in the growth and development of the Department of Statistics and the University at large. He has been teaching statistical computing courses in the Department, helping students to utilize various statistical software for data analysis. He has also served as a resource person for MOUAU-LISA, IMSU-LISA, NAU-LISA, and Federal Polytechnic Oko, providing training on R and Python for Data Science. Dr. Enogwe has made significant contributions to university governance and academic service. He serves as the Secretary of the Departmental Academic Quality Assurance Committee (2024–present), member of the Departmental Postgraduate Board (2023–present), and Level Adviser (2021–present). Additionally, he is a member of Examination Moderation Committee (2021-present), Curriculum Review and Development Committee (2021-present), and Documentation & Library Committee for Accreditation (2021-present), Statistics Course Recovery & Harmonization Committee (2025–present), Chairman of the Secretarial sub-committee for the COLPAS Maiden Conference (2025–present), and College Representative to the School of General Studies (2025–present), MOUAU. He currently serves as Publicity Secretary of the Institute of Operational Research and Management Science of Nigeria (IORMS) and previously held the position of Assistant General Secretary (2023–2025). He has served as member Local Organizing Committee (LOC) of Several Conferences. Dr. Enogwe is an active researcher with over 31 peer-reviewed journal publications and 33 conference papers. He is a member of several professional organizations, including the Chartered Institute of Statisticians of Nigeria (CISON), the Professional Statisticians of Nigeria (PSSN), and the International Biometric Society (IBS). He is happily married to Mrs. Chinenye Eucharia Samuel-Enogwe, an English Language expert, and they enjoy a strong and flourishing family life grounded in faith and mutual support.
specialization: Econometrics, Operations Research
